sloka: स वायुसूनुः कुपितश्चिक्षेप शिखरं गिरेः।त्रिशिरास्तच्छरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्बिभेद बहुधा बली ।। ६.७०.३४ ।।
transliteration: sa vāyusūnuḥ kupitaścikṣepa śikharaṁ gireḥ।triśirāstaccharaistīkṣṇairbibheda bahudhā balī ।। 6.70.34 ।।

translations.english: The son of the wind god in anger hurled a top of the mountain on mighty Trisira, who split the mountain into several pieces with an arrow.
